summary: Frontend-only test of the new Agency Dashboard summary section. All 4 summary cards (Basic Information, Services, Rates, Availability) render correctly with agency master-profile defaults. All Edit buttons open the wizard on the correct step. Independent provider regression is clean.

issues: Known/ignored React hydration <span>/<tr>/<option>/<select> instrumentation console warnings still present (per request, ignored).

critical_code_review_comments: AgencyDashboard.js appears reasonably scoped; ensure the summary section gracefully handles agencies with empty default_services / default_rates / default_availability (not tested here because seed agency has full defaults).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified via Playwright: after agency login at /dashboard, [data-testid=agency-profile-summary] renders four cards agency-card-basic-info/services/rates/availability. Basic card shows 'Elite Agency Demo', 'Paris, France', 'English, French, Italian', 'Premium agency'. Services shows Inclusive (GFE, Body to body, Erotic massage) and Extras (Dinner date €150, Overnight €800). Rates shows INCALL/OUTCALL columns 1h/2h/3h/Overnight in €. Availability shows '7 of 7 days available' and Mon–Sun 10:00 to 22:00. Edit buttons: agency-edit-basic-info-btn → wizard Step 1 (Basic Info active, form pre-filled); agency-edit-services-btn → Step 2 (Services active, Escort tab selected); agency-edit-rates-btn and agency-edit-availability-btn → Step 3 (Rates & Availability active); agency-settings-btn → Step 1. Companion-profiles-heading still present with Sofia/Valentina/Amara. Independent provider regression: provider1@lumiere.com lands on Sophia's provider dashboard with its own Basic Info/Photos steps and no agency-profile-summary present — unaffected.
